场景：图书馆（实体 9971429d-863e-499e-b7c5-902d30e0f6a2）。

【权威事实】appearance 仅登记「现代图书馆，明窗净几，装修简洁」；sceneSpatial 仍 status=draft、elements 为空，房间尺寸、层高、朝向、入口/出口、门、书架正反与固定物体间距均未确认，参考图不可见区域一律不推断。故不发明窗户、门、出口、走廊、地理方向或尺寸，也不新增家具与人物。角色、道具、服装外观以各自参考图为准，不用文字改写。

【本片拍摄约定·仅属影片走位，不写入实体中心】1) 沿用同一套画面：连续笔直浅木书架墙背景、浅木地板、灰绿色椅、顶部灯带的柔和均匀顶光。2) 主阅读桌 T1＝该画面中最靠近机位的那张浅木长桌，是唯一交互锚点；空间语言只用 near side 近侧（机位侧＝A 侧）／far side 远侧（B 侧）与画面左右，不使用方位词与数值。3) 机位始终在 T1 近侧、略偏 A 左手侧，越过桌面看向远侧，全片不跨越 A–B 交互轴、不左右镜像。4) 桌面中性阅览用品（打开的书、玻璃杯、纸张、扁平阅读物等）按各镜真实锚帧原位保留，不虚构数量、不增删、不移动。5) 剧情道具只有两件：那把无鞘太刀与 B 脱下的休闲服外衣。6) 刀链：S1 A 放下（无鞘）→ S2/S3 平放在桌面近侧 A 右手边 → S4 B 取走并带离 → S5 桌面与 A 腰边均无刀、无鞘。7) 衣链：S3 B 只脱休闲服外衣，平放在远侧桌面她自己左手边（绝不挂椅背，椅背全程空置）→ S4 留在原处 → S5 A 取走穿上，远侧桌面清空该外衣。8) 服装口径：A 只脱藏青制服外套（银色肩甲与前臂甲随外套一并移走），保留内层、长裤与靴；随后把 B 留下的同一件外衣罩在自己衣物之外；A·派生＝同一个 A（同脸、发型、体型与基础声音，沿用全局声音 ID S1），不新增角色。9) S5 无锚帧：旧锚帧已移除，按导演备注 S4 结尾 B 已完全出画、A 仍坐近侧，S5 开场只留 A、B 绝不在场，远侧桌面留下那件外衣；currentFilmSpaceInstructions 第 9 条「尊重锚帧中正在离场的 B」针对的是已移除的旧锚帧，由当前导演备注取代，不再沿用。10) 禁止字幕、画面文字与水印，不复现历史抽帧中的字幕。

【时长】按当前镜数据 S1 6s／S2 7s／S3 4s／S4 8s／S5 12s，合计 37s；导演备注明确为诊断测试、非最终 30s 交付，任何镜时长、对白、动作、机位与参考图均不改动。currentFilmSpaceInstructions 正文中「S4 6s／合计 35s」一行与当前镜数据及导演备注不一致，以当前镜数据 S4＝8s、总长 37s 为准，此处仅作说明，不改时长。S4 的 8 秒足以完成起身、取刀、转身与远侧桌沿直线出画；S5 的 12 秒足以完成起身、只脱制服外套与银甲、取远侧外衣穿上、一圈转身与一句对白，均不加速、不删减。

【外观口径】休闲服外衣的颜色、款式与材质以 96e44971-aedc-42da-a534-dc321fd5e350 与 5d0c2f3a-2249-44f3-ab7b-fa89a476610b 参考图为准；用户口径称其为「米驼色外衣」，实体未登记颜色，故不以文字固化颜色，由参考图负责外观。A·派生外观见 c25d9268-6efa-4c1c-9a23-cef25c5ef192，身份仍来自 A 的参考图。

【过期与冲突项】previousSpatialPlan 及其锚点、旧稿「桌面只许三件物品」、旧 S5 锚帧（含远处正在离场的 B）均不再作为场景或开场证据；历史失败输出中 A 坐在画面右、腰间出现刀鞘、出现多张桌子与重复桌品、画面字幕等均为历史缺陷，本轮不沿用。

shots.framing: 中景双人镜，机位在 T1 近侧、略偏 A 左手侧，越过桌面看向远侧；A 从画面左侧进入并在近侧前景坐下，B 在远侧画面右坐姿读书，桌面可见中性阅览用品与那把无鞘太刀。
shots.continuity: 建立图书馆阅读室与主阅读桌 T1 作为唯一固定交互锚点。机位始终在近侧、略偏 A 左手侧，不跨越 A–B 交互轴、不左右镜像。A 从桌区外进入并坐到近侧；B 始终坐远侧；刀从 A 手中转移到桌面近侧 A 右手边、两人之间、B 伸手可及处，刀无鞘。单镜连续，无切镜，时长 6 秒。
shots.startState: A 在阅读区画面左侧外，站立，单手握着那把无鞘太刀，穿藏青立领制服外套（含银色肩甲与前臂甲）、制服长裤与黑靴，腰间无刀、无刀鞘；B 已坐在 T1 远侧画面右，坐姿，身体朝桌面并朝 A，视线落在面前打开的书上；桌面中性阅览用品按参考帧原位保留；图书馆内无其他人走动。
shots.endState: A 坐在 T1 近侧画面左，坐姿，身体朝 B，目光看 B，右手刚放下刀；B 仍坐远侧画面右，坐姿，视线在书上；那把无鞘太刀平放在桌面近侧 A 右手边、两人之间、B 伸手可及处；桌面中性阅览用品原位未动。

Style: live-action cinematic inside a bright modern library reading room, clean anime-influenced character rendering, natural colour grading, soft even overhead lighting, realistic materials, no subtitles, captions, on-screen text or watermarks.
[Shot 1] Composition: a medium two-shot across the single main reading table T1, the long light-wood reading table in the referenced room that stands nearest the camera. Near side means the camera-side edge and Character A's side; far side means the opposite edge and Character B's side. The camera stands on the near side, slightly to Character A's left, looking across the tabletop toward the far side, and it never crosses or mirrors the interaction axis between the two women. Character B is already seated on the far side at screen-right, body facing the tabletop and toward Character A, gaze down on the open book in front of her.
Environment and light: a continuous straight pale-wood shelving wall fills the background, with light wood floor, grey-green chairs and soft even overhead light without hard directional shadow; no door, corridor, exit architecture, window, column, sign or extra person is invented. The tabletop keeps the neutral reading props already present in the reference frames, such as an open book, clear glass tumblers and loose papers or flat reading items, in their existing arrangement; they are set dressing and are not added to, removed, moved or re-counted.
Character A enters from screen-left at an even walking pace, holding the single sword in one hand, wearing her deep navy stand-collar uniform jacket with silver shoulder and forearm armour, navy trousers and black boots, with nothing at her waist and no scabbard. She stops at the near side of T1 and sets the sword down flat on the tabletop at her own right hand, between herself and Character B and within Character B's reach, still unsheathed.
Dominant action: arriving, setting the sword down and sitting; nothing else happens. She then sits down at the near side, body facing Character B, gaze on Character B, her right hand just releasing the sword. Character B stays seated, keeps reading and only lifts her gaze briefly without leaving the page.
Camera: locked-off medium two-shot with one very small, slow push-in across the six seconds, keeping both faces, the sword and the tabletop props in frame throughout.
Once seated, <Subject 2> (S1) says in a low, clear young-adult female voice with a faint rasp and a dry edge, <d>[Chinese] 你倒是清闲。</d> with matching lip movement while her gaze stays on Character B.
Continuity and sound: one continuous six-second shot with no cut, no repositioning and no change of camera side; quiet library room tone, soft footsteps on the wood floor, fabric movement as she sits, and a light metallic settle as the bare blade touches the tabletop. End state: Character A seated at the near side with her right hand just released from the sword, Character B seated on the far side reading, the sword flat on the tabletop at Character A's right hand, and the neutral reading props unchanged.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet library room tone throughout, with soft footsteps on the wood floor, fabric movement as Character A sits down, and a light metallic settle as the unsheathed blade is set on the tabletop.
